name: vinetools
description: VineTools: Amazon Vine extension with no third-party servers, your own Discord webhook and folder sync.

scripts.check: node tools/check-refs.cjs && node tools/check-no-external.cjs && node tools/stamp-headers.cjs --check
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/unit/syncmerge.test.mjs tests/unit/webhook.test.mjs tests/unit/foldersync.test.mjs tests/unit/settings-timestamp.test.mjs tests/unit/sheets.test.mjs tests/unit/smartskip.test.mjs tests/unit/googleservice.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
